data.explanation: This is a private invoice (Privatrechnung) for your daughter's occupational therapy sessions, billed on a private prescription rather than through statutory health insurance, so it is tax-free under §4 No. 14 UStG. You should transfer €430.00 to the IBAN shown by the deadline shown by the app (21 days from the invoice date). Keep this invoice, as medical treatment costs for a child can often be claimed as extraordinary expenses (außergewöhnliche Belastungen) in your tax return. If you believe the amount or services billed are incorrect, contact the practice directly to clarify before paying.
